title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.61: Antagonist reworked into a full trade - it now gives ALL of your invertible/swappable buffs to each ally and takes ALL of their invertible/swappable debuffs onto you (a regular Swap with buffs and debuffs reversed and allies as the targets), instead of only vacuuming ally debuffs.
